data.name: Vijnan
data.gender_notes: Vijnan is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vijnan is a Sanskrit word that signifies deep understanding, knowledge, and wisdom. The name Vijnan carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vijnan usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vijnan is the inner wisdom that guides one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Vijnan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vijnan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vijnan signifies a person who possesses vast knowledge and is intellectually advanced. In Hindu culture, a wise and learned teacher is revered and holds a significant place in society. The name Vijnan is a mark of honor and respect for those who embody this quality.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, knowledge and wisdom are considered essential for spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Vijnan represents an individual who has gone beyond the acquisition of knowledge and has integrated it into their being. This person is not just knowledgeable but is also intellectually deep and spiritually evolved, using their wisdom to help others and make a positive impact on the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vijnan represents wisdom and knowledge, especially higher, intuitive knowledge. It symbolizes the pursuit of truth and understanding, transcending the limitations of the mind and senses.

historical_references.context: An important work in Hindu philosophy and literature.

historical_references.context: Formative texts of Hinduism and Indian philosophy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Vijnan' in modern context refers to an advanced knowledge or wisdom in the fields of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Data Science. IBM Watson, Google Brain, and Microsoft Azure are some of the leading platforms where this advanced knowledge and wisdom are being applied and developed.
